messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: hosted-inference-prod - sustained 5xx burst + p99 latency spike (eu-west-1)
IncidentBot: summary: ~15% increase in 5xx, p99 > 1.2s, region eu-west-1, suspected memory pressure on GPU pool.
Micah: acked. I'm awake, hopping in. any recent deploys?
Kiran: saw a canary/fast rollout 20m ago (deploy-2026-03-15-07c9). traces show repeated KV cache fills and evictions.
Micah: logs: repeated OOMKilled on inference-worker pods. grabbing `kubectl logs` and mem stats now.
Micah: pd snooze 20m while I triage (pd snooze 20m) to avoid waking the rota for noisy alerts.
PagerDutyBot: note: pd snooze recorded. per policy, snooze does not stop escalation chain if primary unacknowledged. paging secondary: Sam.
Sam: oncall-secondary here. I didn't get the push earlier (mobile DND), just saw the email. joining thread now.
Sam: joining Zoom bridge 10.244.12.5:5050
Kiran: quick mitigation idea: disable kernel-level prefetch that spikes mem usage; can flip a runtime flag: `INF_DISABLE_PREFETCH=true` in configmap.
Micah: applying change to configmap and restarting pods one-by-one: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-prod -n prod --grace-period=60`
OpsBot: restart started for deployment/inference-prod, rolling update strategy applied.
Micah: note: I snoozed the pager earlier — worried that snooze might be interpreted as ack in our tooling. PagerDutyBot said snooze doesn't block escalation but our local docs are ambiguous.
PagerDutyBot: secondary did not ack within 6m -> escalating to manager Liam per chain. manager page sent.
Liam: awake, joining. dialing into bridge.
Sam: sorry for delay, mobile DND swallowed the push. turning off DND and verifying push working now.
Micah: after first two restarts p99 improved from ~1250ms -> 430ms; OOM events decreased but a few pods still flapping.
Kiran: heap dump from one flapping pod shows sudden KV store growth after certain prefix patterns. hypothesis: new prompt format in deploy-07c9 causes larger prefixes to be cached.
Micah: temporary mitigation: set `max_kv_entries=200` via configmap patch. applying patch.
Micah: patch applied, restarting the remaining flapping pods.
PagerDutyBot: manager acknowledged the escalation. incident severity preserved.
Liam: thanks. what's customer impact estimate?
IncidentBot: customer-impact-estimate: approx 1.1% of requests in eu-west-1 saw >1s latency, error rate lifted for ~25 minutes starting 03:10 UTC.
Sam: recommend: keep mitigations live until we confirm stability for 30m, then decide on revert of deploy-2026-03-15-07c9.
Micah: starting rollback to previous revision: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-prod -n prod --to-revision=41`. doing gradual traffic shift.
Kiran: I'll prepare a quick regression test that exercises the new prefix behavior and push to CI -> #eng-runtime.
Micah: rollback triggered, watching pod readiness. so far new pods stable and no OOMs in last 4m. p99 trending down to ~320ms.
Sam: filing incident tracker ticket INC-20260315-988 with timeline, root-cause hypothesis, and mitigation steps. I'll own the postmortem.
Micah: action items: (1) clarify pd snooze vs ack behavior in runbook; (2) add mobile DND check to oncall checklist; (3) add guardrails to prefix caching size for future deploys.
Liam: agree. prioritize runbook change and release CI regression test.
OpsBot: alerting quiet for 8m, setting incident to mitigated state. will auto-close if stable for 30m.
Micah: thanks team. ping me if anything flares back, I'll keep monitoring. :coffee:
Sam: noted. will post a short blameless postmortem and link to incident ticket.
Kiran: will upload relevant heap dumps and KV traces to the ticket.
IncidentBot: thread archived to incident INC-20260315-988; reopen if further alerts fire.
